scope: Single-instance from-zero budget × already dispatched kick with actual 504 and unavailable/pending member observation.

checks.claim: One real from-zero run, one live application process and one activity epoch; no restart, second instance, preloaded active_ms or synthetic clock.
checks.missing: BLOCKED for the missing premise; no historical PASS import.

checks.claim: Exactly one real audited kick POST for the selected group/target and actual 504 HTTP completion, followed by an actual member GET held pending. Route-prepared status and configuration alone do not prove delivery.
checks.missing: BLOCKED if the first POST never happened or no pending member request is observed; already proved excess dispatch remains FAIL.

checks.claim: The remote membership converges within the original two-second guarantee; QA may withhold the HTTP observation but must not make the remote effect itself violate that guarantee to manufacture a product failure.
checks.missing: Invalid fixture/premise is BLOCKED; retain actual request/effect timestamps and state.

checks.claim: Use original creation C and actual stop D in one true process clock, with complete continuous activity from creation and unsaved tail. Duration interval is [D.lower-C.upper,D.upper-C.lower], without rounding or tolerance.
checks.fail: A trusted complete activity/actual decision/new dispatch lower bound >60000ms; or actual new turn after a matching stop decision.
checks.pass: Complete decision/activity upper bound <=60000ms with all identities/completeness obligations and independent public behavior fulfilled.
checks.blocked: Interval straddles 60000 or lacks actual creation/decision, epoch completeness, tail, or process identity. Public terminal/COMMIT cannot substitute.

checks.claim: Pair the real termination decision and terminal COMMIT by original run/group/application/clock and execution attempt. COMMIT and public visibility are separate diagnostic times.
checks.fail: Observed contradictory status/history or dispatch after decision.
checks.blocked: Missing pairing without another proven violation; late COMMIT alone does not establish late stop.

checks.claim: At and after actual stop, no newly initiated audit, Agent turn, kick POST or independent new side-effect operation; keep a finite post-stop observation window and record it as diagnostic coverage, not a new SLA.
checks.qualification: A remote effect from the single POST initiated before stop may land later and is not new dispatch. Correlate it to that request by unique case/group/target and count; do not assert zero cumulative effect just because stop occurred.

checks.claim: Preserve the selected GET request id and pending snapshot, then responseClosedAt/responseClosedBeforeFinish before QA release, TTL, kill or teardown.
checks.qualification: closed-before-finish proves transport closure, not alone its application cancellation cause. Normal per-request timeout remains a possible cause unless separate actual cancellation evidence distinguishes it. Do not invent an abort-time SLA.

checks.claim: Original run reaches failed/wall_clock with consistent actual decision and durable state, activeAgentRunId clears, existing step/history remains visible, and no false successful or failed kick outcome is invented from unknown.
checks.qualification: Run failed/wall_clock is not automatically tool failure. An unfinished/unknown current effect must be reported accurately rather than fabricated as kicked:true or known not-applied.

checks.claim: Inspect already available exact dispatch/ledger/public and timing violations before raising missing-witness/transport-cause BLOCKED. Preserve earliest real FAIL through cleanup.
checks.qualification: The final report separates PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED per claim, raw status and reviewed status. No repeat filtering of first failure.

checks.claim: This no-restart budget/safety experiment does not verify A5.8 arbitrary restart continuation and does not close BLK-EXT-004/REC-007 or other recovery FAIL. D039 chosen conservative unknown behavior is an engineering direction, not an accepted standard deviation.
checks.qualification: Additional running second-instance competition remains independently NOT_RUN and is not a new condition for closing this two-factor supplement.

reviewLimits: No SUT, controller, database or browser was started or contacted.
No signed historical report, QA source or product was changed.
Engineering implementation disclosures inform fault placement only; original requirements and accepted adjudication remain the assertion basis.
actualRunReviewRequired: Pinned SUT/QA/target/suite identities and immutable first-attempt events
Creation, single epoch and actual stop/COMMIT raw witnesses
Gateway request/response/effect ledger including exact pending request id and cleanup ordering
Public original run/group/step state, audit/turn ledger and bounded post-stop snapshots
Cause-specific PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED and owned-resource cleanup without masking primary FAIL
